verdict.rationale: Square documents multiple locations per account, with location info editable in the Dashboard and per-location settings such as custom receipt text. Payouts can be filtered by location ID, which is a thin form of per-location reporting. missing for 10: evidence of per-location device assignment and management, per-location sales/operational reporting beyond payout filtering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-location operations.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can run multiple locations with per-location devices, settings, and reporting

citations.quote: Newly created accounts only have this single location, but more locations can be created.
Sellers can review and edit location information in the Square Dashboard
A seller can customize the receipts issued for a location with two text fields.
Learn how to filter payouts by location ID, status, and time range and sort them in ascending or descending order.
